description: FreeBSD LinuxKPI compatibility headers and runtime source inventory required by imported drivers.

patches.reason: Match the Linux 6.6 list_sort comparator const contract selected by the imported LinuxKPI headers.
Report the exact LinuxKPI current allocation stage when the EdgeOS bridge cannot create task or memory-management state.
Implement owned linear socket-buffer head and tail expansion required by ath12k transmit encapsulation.
Expose the live hardware queue stopped state required by ath12k recovery.
Provide the IEEE 802.11 radio-measurement, extended-capability, element, frequency, and block-ack response definitions required by the imported ath11k and ath12k drivers.
Expose the canonical Linux list-head initializer and list-cut operation used by ath12k hardware groups and receive reassembly.
Provide socket-buffer expansion, trailer growth, and fragment-list accounting required by ath12k data paths.
Expose the Open Firmware node associated with a LinuxKPI device for ath12k platform and PCI firmware selection.
Provide the RCU lock-state compatibility checks used by the imported ath12k driver.
Correct the checked object-array allocation multiplication used by ath12k data-path setup.
Provide cleanup-based bottom-half spinlock guards used by ath12k WMI parsing.
Provide Linux work-container recovery and bottom-half workqueue routing required by ath12k PCI completion handling.
Provide late system-sleep callback initializers and disabled-configuration forms required by ath12k PCI power management.
Match Linux PCI driver-name constness and expose the CPU-mask type used by ath12k MSI affinity callbacks.
Provide the channel power spectral density and per-link station information fields consumed by the imported Qualcomm Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 drivers.
Provide Linux atomic notifier chains required to preserve ath12k panic callback registration.
Provide transmit-BSS, local power-constraint, and per-link station statistics interfaces required by the imported ath11k and ath12k drivers.
